structural_change: S81-TOPK successor (safe-design rebuild after 2 stopped legacy gates): FQ 8x592 / OFQ 4x593 flop arrays -> 10 p192 32x128 SRAM (registered showahead, exact, 0 cycles); line pool 6x 128x256 -> p192_mir (faces 5.09/um, was 9.98); bank read mux = registered one-hot KEPT selects (37 pairs x16 loads, 3 b1 copies); RST64 regional reset copies (<=256 loads) + 2-stage reset landing; INDEXED13 1037 reserved cycles. Macros: two abutted W/E-pin stacks on the 43.2 lattice (mir x3 + rc x5 per column, M4-pitch abutment), PARALLEL FALLBACK B: line-pool rd faces OUTWARD to the W (41 um) / E (56 um) margins, centre channel carries the tie/wd faces; outline 324x561.6 (top band 71 um), full-width top band, N pins <=5.6/um, clock N centre. 324 wide keeps two quarters inside the 680 um column.

reroute_reason.reason: New successor master (FIFO SRAM + p192 macros + one-hot kept selects + RST64); legacy INDEXED13/RST64 gates stopped on storage gap (689851d41). Earlier closed quarter retained.
